name: R-Serve v1.0.1 - File Browser & Cron Jobs
body:
# R-Serve v1.0.1

## 🎉 What's New

### ✅ File Browser (Fully Functional)
- Browse directories with file/folder icons 📁📄
- Navigate up/down directory tree
- Open files with system default app
- Display file size and modification date
- Sort folders first, alphabetically

### ✅ Cron Jobs Manager (Fully Functional)
- List existing cron jobs from crontab
- Add new cron jobs with schedule validation
- Delete cron jobs with confirmation
- macOS/Linux support (crontab integration)
- Schedule format: `* * * * *` (minute hour day month weekday)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- Fixed all placeholder issues from v1.0.0
- Both File Browser and Cron Jobs now working end-to-end

---

## ✨ Features

✅ Multi-version service manager (PHP, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Node.js, Python, Nginx, Apache)
✅ Click-to-install & version switching
✅ **File Browser** - navigate projects, open files
✅ **Cron Jobs** - manage scheduled tasks
✅ Start/Stop services
✅ Cross-platform (macOS, Windows, Linux)
✅ Native Apple Silicon support
✅ Modern dark UI

---

## 📝 Full Changelog

**v1.0.1** (2026-06-17)
- ✅ Implemented File Browser with filesystem navigation
- ✅ Implemented Cron Jobs manager (macOS/Linux)
- ✅ Fixed all Known Issues from v1.0.0
- 🔧 No breaking changes

**Upgrade from v1.0.0:** Download and replace - no migration needed!
